outcomes.detail: Rd8+ is the move: it gives check, and it forces checkmate in two. Their own pawns on f7, g7 and h7 block every square for the king, so the check on the back rank cannot be escaped. This is a back-rank mate: when the king is shut in behind its own pawns, look at every check on the last rank first.
